parrafo.es: One Stop Cabinet Shop es un taller familiar en Port St. Lucie dedicado al refacing y la fabricación de gabinetes de cocina, closets y muebles a medida. Ray y su equipo acompañan el proyecto de principio a fin.
parrafo.en: One Stop Cabinet Shop is a family-run shop in Port St. Lucie dedicated to kitchen cabinet refacing and custom cabinetry, closets and built-ins. Ray and his crew walk the project from start to finish.

hero.imagen_alt: Cocina blanca con detalles dorados renovada por One Stop Cabinet Shop

parrafo_1.es: One Stop Cabinet Shop es un negocio familiar dirigido por Ray, que atiende Port St. Lucie y el sur de Florida. El taller fabrica gabinetes de cocina, hace refacing completo y construye closets y muebles empotrados a medida.
parrafo_1.en: One Stop Cabinet Shop is a family business run by Ray, serving Port St. Lucie and South Florida. The shop builds kitchen cabinets, does full cabinet refacing, and makes custom closets and built-ins.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes destacan el diseño cuidado y la atención al detalle en cada etapa, desde la primera cotización hasta la instalación final.
parrafo_2.en: Clients point to the careful design and the attention to detail at every stage, from the first quote to the final installation.

texto.es: Nos cuentas tu proyecto y coordinamos una visita para medir tu cocina o espacio.
texto.en: Tell us about your project and we set up a visit to measure your kitchen or space.

texto.es: Te mostramos opciones de acabado y el precio exacto antes de empezar.
texto.en: We show you finish options and the exact price before we start.

texto.es: Fabricamos cada pieza en el taller a la medida de tu espacio.
texto.en: We build every piece in the shop to the measurements of your space.

texto.es: Instalamos y dejamos tu cocina o closet listo para usarse.
texto.en: We install it and leave your kitchen or closet ready to use.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el tamaño y los acabados. Llámanos y te damos el estimado sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on size and finishes. Call us for a free estimate, no strings attached.

texto.es: Renovamos tus gabinetes existentes con puertas y acabados nuevos, sin demoler la cocina.
texto.en: We refresh your existing cabinets with new doors and finishes, no need to gut the kitchen.

texto.es: Cocinas completas fabricadas e instaladas a la medida exacta de tu espacio.
texto.en: Full kitchens built and installed to the exact measurements of your space.

texto.es: Walk-ins y closets organizados con cada estante pensado para tu ropa.
texto.en: Walk-ins and reach-in closets organized with every shelf planned for your things.

texto.es: Muebles de TV, vitrinas y consolas flotantes hechos a la medida de tu pared.
texto.en: TV consoles, display cases and floating units built to your wall's exact size.

pie.es: ¿Tienes otro proyecto en mente? Llámanos, en más de 10 años hemos construido de todo.
pie.en: Have another project in mind? Call us, in over 10 years we have built just about everything.

items.quote: We did a full renovation of the kitchen with One Stop Cabinet Shop and the service provided exceeded our highest expectations. Ray is very creative and experienced designer who combined with great care and attention to details.

Working with Ray was enjoyable and easy. He does very high-quality custom work. He built and installed our kitchen cabinets and also did a smaller project for us in our laundry room, all of which turned out great.

After careful consideration of 8 estimates and becoming educated in the process of cabinet refacing and cabinet installation, One Stop Cabinet Shop became the number one company I felt most comfortable contracting with.
